QuestInfo.name: Where Everybody Knows Your Name
QuestInfo.0: If everyone in this world has forgotten you, wouldn't it be better to return to where people do remember you?
QuestInfo.1: If everyone in this world has forgotten you, wouldn't it be better to return to where people do remember you?
QuestInfo.2: Fleeing from a Maple World where you've been forgotten, you find in horror that the foxes have now forgotten you, too. The foxes are scared of you, an outsider, and chase you out. Hiding beneath the fox tree, the Fox God pulls you into her space. She has forgotten you as well, but has quickly deduces that your story is true and bestows a new blessing upon you.
